name: Loon Cove
tagline: Freezing water, thoughtfully arranged. You provide the flinching.
positioning: A membership network of cold-plunge studios for people who want the ritual without the garden-hose-and-chest-freezer phase of their life.

hero.h1: Cold water. Warm design. No excuses left.
hero.sub: Loon Cove is a network of temperature-controlled plunge studios built for people who read one article about cold exposure and haven't shut up since. Book a tub, breathe, leave smug.

features.title: Verified 38°F, every time
features.description: Our tubs are held at a real temperature by real chillers, not by you dumping a bag of gas-station ice and hoping. Every plunge logs its exact temp to your app.

features.title: Book in 12 seconds
features.description: Pick a studio, pick a tub, pick a time. No calling, no waitlist theater, no membership consultant named Kyle circling back. The slot is yours.

features.title: Streaks that actually mean something
features.description: We track your plunges, duration, and recovery breaths so you can prove to your group chat that this personality trait has data behind it.

features.title: Studios that don't smell like a gym
features.description: Cedar, quiet, good towels. Each cove is designed so the worst part of your visit is the water, which is the entire point.

testimonials.quote: I spent four months and $2,300 building a plunge setup in my garage. My wife asked me to leave. Loon Cove is closer, colder, and doesn't leak into the drywall.
testimonials.name: Marcus Fenn

testimonials.quote: I switched our whole run club to Loon Cove. The temp is consistent, the booking never fails, and nobody has to touch a mystery ice bag anymore. That last part sold everyone.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan

testimonials.quote: I came for the anti-inflammatory whatever. I stayed because it's the only 40 minutes of my week where my phone genuinely cannot reach me. The cold is a bonus.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

pricing.blurb: For the curious who aren't ready to commit to a personality.
For the person this is now becoming.
features: Access to every Loon Cove studio

pricing.blurb: For people who mention cold water on first dates.

homepage.footerBlurb: Loon Cove operates cold-plunge studios for individuals who take recovery seriously and themselves slightly less so. Get in the water.
